use_case_summary: Primary: internal engineering code search across mono-repo + dozens of service repos (approx 12k repos, 1.2B LOC). Secondary: support agents + technical KB. Re-rank top results with cross-encoder for precision-sensitive queries (API debugging, compliance). Frequent re-indexing (nightly full; hot reindex on deploys).
technical_requirements: Indexing scale: initial corpus ~100M embeddings, plans to scale to ~1B over 12 months
Re-index cadence: nightly full index + event-driven hot reindex (developer pushes) — want low downtime and incremental updates
Query SLOs: p50 <40ms, p95 <150ms for code-search queries including rerank step
Cost targets: <= $0.005 per query on average (including embed + vector search + rerank), budget sensitivity across 50M qps/mo
Model preferences: open models (quantized Llama-2 13B or similar) for embeddings, cross-encoder reranker (smaller distil variant for cost) with fallback to bi-encoder only
Routing & fallback: need automatic fallback to cheaper model when Dedicated capacity constrained; prefer same API surface across Private/Dedicated
Security: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, audit logs for all token usage, customer-managed KMS for keys
Data residency: EU customers require EU-only storage and control plane routes
poc_plan: Week 0: finalize scope and datasets — pick 3 representative repos + 50k golden queries
Week 1: ingest pipeline + embedding baseline (2 candidate embed models), measure throughput and cost
Week 2: implement rerank pipeline (dense retrieval -> top-200 -> cross-encoder top-50), measure p95 latency and cost
Week 3: scale tests (simulate 100M embeddings, run nightlies), produce internal eng doc + recommendations
Deliverable: perf matrix (latency, cost/token, cost/query) and recommended Dedicated configuration + quantization profile
